simple.summary: כֶּשֶׂד (Kesed) means Kesed , a relative of Abraham First listed occurrence: Gen 22 22.

definitions.full: H3777. Kesed כֶּ֫שֶׂד proper name, masculine son of Nahor according to Gen 22:22 (J; perhaps originally personified, or assumed ancestor, of following, see Di Dl Par 201 ).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root of uncertain meaning;
